_comment: GDELT country codes that are not countries. These are KNOWN, not errors: a story
about a ship in the Atlantic really does geocode to an ocean.
HANDOFF.md §3.4: oceans render as plain pins and are never containers — there is
no boundary to outline and no country to represent in the §2.4 country-top layer.
Anything NOT listed here and NOT in the crosswalk is a genuine gap and gets a loud
log plus a degraded pin, counted in the run summary (§8).
OS is 0.096% of location mentions in the measured sample. OC is listed for the
same reason as the pre-emptive crosswalk overrides: it costs nothing and it is
documented in §3.4 as the other ocean code.
